# Shuttle Brief
"A medium sized medical rapid response vessel designed for CGP use. Fitted with a cryogenics bay as well as a chembay."
# Ship Functions Shuttle Console Button 7 - Turns on all gyroscopes and thrusters. Shuttle Console Button 8 - Turns off all gyroscopes and thrusters.
# Cryogenics
This Freezer and Pump are linked up to your Cryo System. Set these on to enable the use of your Cryopod for healing CGP Officers who are in a state of excessive damage.
